The token will be securely saved using Android Keystore (AES-GCM) hardware encryption. Plaintext is never written to disk or logs.
This app is the management center for the Rclone Magisk module and requires ROOT superuser permissions to interact with the backend gateway and mount cloud storage.
Tip: Please choose \"Grant\" in the system superuser prompt. If denied previously or no prompt appears, open Magisk / KernelSU / APatch and enable superuser access for this app.
Token is encrypted via Android Keystore and kept locally.

• The app strictly interacts via typed request client contracts; raw rclone RC is never exposed.\n• Passwords/tokens are encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 on Gateway side; APIs never return plaintext.\n• Remote & file deletions are protected by 60s single-use confirmation tokens and dry-run.

Grant admin privileges to the local companion app?

• Standard: Manage files, remotes, mounts, and job scheduling (recommended for daily use).
• Admin: Additionally allows exporting plaintext credentials and clearing audit logs.
